Why order from a local fabricator

Every window is made to your opening, in our shop, by the same people who install it.

📐

Made to measure

Each unit is built to your exact rough opening, so installation is clean and there's no filler to hide gaps.

❄️

Built for −40

Multi-chamber PVC profiles, steel reinforcement and warm-edge double or triple glazing rated for Manitoba's climate.

⏱️

Short lead times

Because we fabricate locally, most orders are ready in weeks, not months — and we can fix things fast if anything ever needs service.

How it works

  1. Free measurement visit

    We come out, measure every opening and talk through the options with you.

  2. Written quote

    You get a clear price per window — no surprises, no pressure.

  3. Fabrication

    Your windows are cut, welded, glazed and tested in our Winnipeg shop.

  4. Installation

    We remove the old units, install the new ones, insulate, seal and clean up.
